categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions workflows (.github/workflows/ci.yml, custom actions) and CI runner scripts under ci/ to cache and share qa-assets across CI jobs.
categories.rationale: Reduces intermittent CI timeouts by fetching test assets once per workflow run rather than per job. While fixing CI reliability issues is valued in Build and CI, the issue is relatively infrequent (noted as occurring only in two PRs over the past year), making the improvement worthwhile but reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled 'Tests' and updates test asset download and verification utilities in test/download_utils.py (+153/-10) for unit test vectors and fuzz corpora.
categories.rationale: Adds SHA-256 hash manifest verification and centralized handling for test vectors and fuzz corpora in test/download_utils.py. The changes enhance asset handling robustness and reduce test job flakiness, but represent an incremental infrastructure improvement without blocking core testing needs.
